fsm_states_ltssm.name: Detect
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Initial state after PERST# deassertion or unrecoverable Link error. Detect.Quiet → Detect.Active sub-states. Transmitter looks for a far-end receiver via differential detect circuitry.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Polling
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Bit-lock + symbol-lock + Lane polarity inversion + Link / Lane number exchange. Sub-states: Polling.Active, Polling.Configuration, Polling.Compliance, Polling.Speed (Gen 1 stays at 2.5 GT/s).

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Configuration
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Link Width and Lane Number negotiation. Sub-states: Configuration.Linkwidth.Start, Configuration.Linkwidth.Accept, Configuration.Lanenum.Wait, Configuration.Lanenum.Accept, Configuration.Complete, Configuration.Idle.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L0
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Normal operational state. TLPs and DLLPs flow in both directions; SKP ordered sets inserted every 1180-1538 symbols for clock-tolerance compensation.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L0s
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Low-power state that can be entered + exited individually on TX or RX direction. Fast exit via FTS (Fast Training Sequence) ordered sets.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L1
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Lower-power state requiring both directions in agreement. Slower exit than L0s; goes through Recovery.RcvrLock then Recovery.RcvrCfg then L0.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L2
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Deep sleep; REFCLK may be off; main-power may remain. Re-entry requires Beacon (or WAKE# at system level) and a full LTSSM restart from Detect.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Recovery
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Re-train an already-trained Link without going through full Detect/Polling/Configuration. Used to clear errors and to enter L0s/L1. Sub-states: Recovery.RcvrLock, Recovery.RcvrCfg, Recovery.Idle, Recovery.Speed (future).

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Loopback
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Test mode; Loopback Master transmits patterns to Loopback Slave, which retransmits them back. Used for production test and debug.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Disabled
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Transmitter outputs Electrical Idle on all Lanes; Link is electrically off. Re-entry to active state requires a state-machine reset or PERST# cycle.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Hot Reset
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Software-initiated reset; goes from L0/Recovery to Detect after transmitting TS1 with Hot Reset bit set.

fsm_states_data_link_layer.name: DL_Inactive
fsm_states_data_link_layer.description: Reported when LTSSM is not in L0 / L0s / L1 / Recovery; Transaction Layer sees the Link as unusable.

fsm_states_data_link_layer.name: DL_Init
fsm_states_data_link_layer.description: Flow Control initialization phase (InitFC1 → InitFC2 DLLP exchange) on VC0.

fsm_states_data_link_layer.name: DL_Active
fsm_states_data_link_layer.description: Normal operation; TLP send/receive + ACK/NAK + UpdateFC.

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_FORM
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Transaction Layer assembles the TLP header + payload + (optional) ECRC.

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_SEQ
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Data Link Layer attaches the next Sequence Number and computes the 16-bit LCRC.

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_FRAME
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Physical Layer 8b/10b-encodes the bytes, prepends STP, appends END (or EDB for nullified).

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_RETRY
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Retry Buffer holds every transmitted TLP until acked. On NAK or REPLAY_TIMER expiration, replay starting from the first un-acked sequence number.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_DECODE
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Physical Layer detects STP, captures the TLP bytes between STP and END, 8b/10b-decodes them.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_LCRC
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Data Link Layer recomputes the 16-bit LCRC + verifies Sequence Number monotonicity.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_ACKNAK
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: If LCRC + Sequence are good, schedule an Ack DLLP; else NAK with the last good Sequence Number.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_TL
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Hand the TLP to Transaction Layer for type-specific processing (Memory / I/O / Configuration / Message).

fsm_hints.trigger: Host writes SQyTDBL → controller fetches; controller writes CQE + asserts MSI-X → host reads CQE + writes CQyHDBL.
fsm_hints.rule: Controller is slave at protocol layer; does not push unsolicited data (except AER completions).
fsm_hints.abort: Admin Abort (OPC=08h) targets SQID:CID; controller may complete normally or with Command Abort Requested.

anti_deadlock_rule: Host shall not write SQyTDBL/CQyHDBL with invalid (out-of-range) value. Doing so with an outstanding AER raises Invalid Doorbell Write Value; associated queue should be deleted and recreated.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on / PCIe Conventional Reset: CC=0; CSTS.RDY=0; CSTS.SHST=00b; volatile features reset to defaults; persistent features reload; PCI Config Space enumerated by BIOS/OS.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CSTS.RDY: 0 — not ready until CC.EN=1 and bring-up succeeds.
default_ready_state_recommendation.Phase Tag: All CQE Phase Tag bits = 0 after CC.EN=0→1.

configurations.name: x1 Link
configurations.description: 1 Lane per direction; simplest, lowest-bandwidth (2.5 GT/s = ~2 Gb/s effective per direction).

configurations.name: x2 / x4 / x8 / x12 / x16 / x32 Link
configurations.description: Aggregated Lanes; data bytes striped Lane-by-Lane starting at Lane 0. STP / SDP must be placed on Lane 0.

timing_dependency_rule: In-band ordering enforced by PCIe TLP ordering (Strong Ordering, Relaxed Ordering, ID-based). SQ doorbell write observed before corresponding SQ fetch. CQE write observed before MSI-X interrupt. Host polls CQE Phase Tag (controller's CQ Tail is internal).

fsm_states_controller.name: RESET
fsm_states_controller.description: After PCIe Conventional Reset / FLR / NSSR / CC.EN 1→0; CSTS.RDY=0.

fsm_states_controller.name: INITIALIZING
fsm_states_controller.description: CC.EN 0→1 detected; controller validates CC/AQA; sets CSTS.RDY=1.

fsm_states_controller.name: READY
fsm_states_controller.description: CSTS.RDY=1; controller services Admin SQ doorbell writes.

fsm_states_controller.name: RUNNING
fsm_states_controller.description: I/O queue pairs created; controller services I/O doorbells.

fsm_states_controller.name: SHUTDOWN_PROCESSING
fsm_states_controller.description: Host wrote CC.SHN; controller drains; CSTS.SHST=01b.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: PCIe Conventional Reset / FLR / NSSR / CC.EN 1→0
Create I/O CQ + Create I/O SQ pair succeed

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_PCI_ENUM
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: BIOS / OS enumerates PCI Function; assigns BAR0/BAR1.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_READ_CAP_VS
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Read CAP + VS; capture CAP.TO, DSTRD, MQES, MPSMIN/MAX, CSS, NSSRS.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_RESET_IF_RDY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: If CSTS.RDY=1, write CC.EN=0; poll RDY → 0.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_CONFIG_ADMIN
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Allocate Admin SQ/CQ; write AQA + ASQ + ACQ.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_PROGRAM_CC
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Set CC.MPS / AMS / CSS / IOSQES=6 / IOCQES=4; CC.EN=1.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_WAIT_READY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Poll CSTS.RDY until 1 or CAP.TO timeout.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_IDENTIFY
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Identify Controller + NS List + Identify NS.

fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.name: HOST_CREATE_IO_QUEUES
fsm_states_host_initialization_flow.description: Create I/O CQ first, then Create I/O SQ.
